description: This file defines a Flutter widget called PillTextField, which wraps around the native TextField to provide a styled, reusable input component with customizable icons, labels, hints, and behavior.

classes.name: PillTextField
classes.description: A stylized, reusable text input widget with pill shape, icons, and padding, encapsulating the Flutter TextField for consistent design across the app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, primarily returning a TextField with configured decoration and behavior.
